info.title: Project-one Nodes
info.description: Active M03-M10 human and agent contract. The nodes application profile admits only read_only / collect_facts.v1. The cumulative components profile also admits explicitly minted systemd_components / protocol 1.1 and only fixed node_exporter install/start/stop/remove/observe, exact artifact and renewal routes; maintenance/logs require the cumulative maintenance profile with explicit protocol 1.2 enrollment; later owners remain unavailable. Machine routes use only the exact configured machine HTTPS origin (or shared Admin HTTPS origin) with an independent node credential; browser cookies do not grant machine authority. Facts report the agent-visible kernel and filesystem, not target qualification.

post.description: Leases the next task. With wait_seconds, control holds the claim until work arrives or the wait ends; this long-poll is the fallback when the agent session stream cannot be opened (ADR 0007). An empty object claims at once.

observed_at.description: Agent observation year 2020 through 2200; never used for server connectivity or lease clocks.

sequence.description: Per-node task sequence; grows by one per task of the node (ADR 0011).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds control may hold the claim for new work; at most the heartbeat interval.

acknowledged_sequence.description: Highest task sequence the agent acknowledged.

last_heartbeat_at.description: Last authenticated heartbeat or current task lease renewal; metric/fact observation timestamps remain independent.

Resync.description: Recover all local work, then use acknowledged_sequence as the cursor (ADR 0011).

TaskAcknowledgementRequest.description: The agent holds this lease and executes it once control confirms (ADR 0011).

Pacing.description: How control paces an agent at runtime (ADR 0013).

heartbeat_seconds.description: Mean time between two heartbeats of an idle agent.

jitter_percent.description: Spreads each interval evenly around heartbeat_seconds.

reconnect_base_seconds.description: Ceiling of the full-jitter delay after the first failed cycle.

reconnect_max_seconds.description: Largest ceiling of the full-jitter delay; not below reconnect_base_seconds.

AgentRetryAfter.description: Whole seconds the agent waits at least before it repeats a refused call (ADR 0018). Sent with 429 RATE_LIMITED, when the node or client address is over its limit for the call, and with 503 AGENT_OVERLOADED, when control sheds the call by priority.
